page.content:
Co-creator who built Night Vale as a desert community-radio fiction.

How Joseph Fink connects

  • Topic: Welcome to Night Vale — Joseph Fink co-created Welcome to Night Vale.
  • Work: Welcome to Night Vale (show) — Fink co-writes and produces the Welcome to Night Vale show.
  • Faction: Night Vale Presents — Fink co-founded Night Vale Presents around the mothership show.

What is Joseph Fink?

Joseph Fink co-created Welcome to Night Vale with Jeffrey Cranor, produces Night Vale Presents, and co-wrote the novels that take Cecil's town off the microphone.

Key threads lead to Welcome to Night Vale, Welcome to Night Vale (show) and Night Vale Presents.
